task_description: Implement GitHub Issue #23: cache the /prediction result (including the Bedrock narrative) in DynamoDB keyed by seriesId + series situation (win counts) + language + model + accuracy so repeat same-situation requests do NOT call Bedrock and a game-result update invalidates the cache; add API Gateway throttling with a CDK assertion test; and emit CloudWatch metrics for cache hit rate and Bedrock call count (EMF preferred to avoid new IAM). Backend + infra + docs. Incremental commits on feat/mlb-postseason-site; no push/PR/deploy (orchestrator owns those).

verification.summary: npm run build exit 0 (shared->backend->frontend->infra). npm test: shared 37, backend 124, frontend 194, infra 10 - all pass. npm run synth exit 0; synthesized AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage renders DefaultRouteSettings ThrottlingRateLimit=20 / ThrottlingBurstLimit=40 (criterion 3). Playwright e2e 49/49 pass (prediction UI unchanged; cache is server-side). Test quality verified: criterion-1 test asserts the mocked Bedrock invoker is called exactly once across two identical requests (zero extra calls on 2nd, response equals first) and would fail if the cache were reverted; criterion-2 test mutates high.wins and asserts a 2nd Bedrock call (would fail if the key omitted win counts). No Dockerfile; docker_build skipped.

review.followup: Two non-blocking v1 findings addressed in cf65f6d (store-level dynamo tests + criterion-2 freshness assertion). Finding #3 (throttle is API-wide not /prediction-only) intentionally left as-is and documented.
